column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹575.00
lakh was the net effect
of increase of
₹703.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹128.00 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amounts
in gratuitous grants,
legal charges, medical
reimbursement,
travelling expenses,
contract services,
salary, subsistence
allowance and house
rent allowance.
Decrease was
attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
